results.title: Yoshitomo Nara: Sentinels of Stillness - Hirshhorn Museum and Sculpture Garden | Smithsonian
results.description: Globally renowned artist Yoshitomo Nara will inaugurate the Hirshhorn Sculpture Garden’s West Lawn with Sentinels of Stillness. This exhibition of three monumental artworks emphasizes the interplay between the artist’s life experience and sculpture’s premodern foundation: hand-building with clay.

results.title: Opening Weekend: Hirshhorn Sculpture Garden - Hirshhorn Museum and Sculpture Garden | Smithsonian
results.description: Join us as we celebrate the reopening of the Hirshhorn Sculpture Garden with a full weekend of art, creativity, and conversation. Be among the first to experience Hiroshi Sugimoto’s revitalized Garden, with 60 artworks on view throughout the reimagined space, as well as the inaugural West Lawn exhibition Yoshitomo Nara: Sentinels of Stillness!
